messages:
maria: Need a compact launch playbook for website copy + launch posts + benchmark narrative + webinar + inbound form routing tied to Hosted/Dedicated/Private. Quick ideas?

jake: I can draft launch posts and the landing page copy. Do we want a separate benchmarks post or fold highlights into the product pages?

elsa: I'll pull run metrics and give 3 public-friendly callouts (latency, throughput, compliance). Can provide a one-line eng quote for the blog.

ryan: Webinar: 30min total. Demo 20, Q&A 10. Panel: Product (maria), Eng (elsa), Ops (ryan), Customer (ask Glint). Demo should show routing/fallback and Dedicated onboarding.

maria: Hero concept: "Predictable inference, wherever you deploy." Keep headline mode-agnostic, below it three quick cards: Hosted -> Try API (free credits), Dedicated -> Reserve capacity, Private -> Contact sales for VPC/on-prem. Each card gets one-line clarifier.

olivia: For inbound routing, add hidden form fields: deployment_mode, interest_tier, region. That lets SDRs auto-route. Example payload stored: {"deployment_mode":"private","interest":"enterprise"}.

jake: Enums: deployment_mode=[hosted,dedicated,private]; interest=[eval,prod,enterprise]; region=[NA,EU,APAC]. We'll wire those into the form.

elsa: Copyable benchmark blurbs (placeholder): "Hosted: ~85ms median token latency; Dedicated: reserved pools delivering 12k tokens/s sustained; Private: VPC + KMS/HSM integrations for compliance."

maria: Launch post sequence: teaser (announce webinar + early access), benchmarks deep dive (tech post), customer spotlight, webinar reminder, launch recap. Each post points to the right CTA per mode.

ryan: I'll draft 6 panel Qs: routing policies, burst handling, fallback strategy, Dedicated onboarding, telemetry access, security for Private.

olivia: Form routing mapping: if deployment_mode==private -> enterprise queue (team-enterprise@); dedicated -> dedicated-sales; hosted -> trial nurture. I'll add to the form builder.

maria: Deliverables: Jake = 3 posts + landing copy by Tue; Elsa = benchmark numbers + 2 eng quotes; Olivia = form fields + routing rules; Ryan = confirm customer panelist + Qs; Maria = hero + prompt snippets (2 per mode).

jake: I'll post drafts to #copy-ops and link back here. :thumbsup:

mkt-bot: Reminder: webinar slot reserved Thu 10am PT. Calendar invite sent.
